note: The living registry of every status, condition, mechanic, enchantment, affix and field effect (Ricardo 2026-07-10). Source of truth for the in-game CODEX (synced to game/prototype/data/effects.json). Extend by ADDING entries — weekly content never requires engine work (canon).

entries.desc: impulse displacement on the hero (boss Wing Gust)

entries.name: Shove
entries.desc: instant displacement on creatures (Rune of the Gale burst)

entries.name: Dodge displacement
entries.desc: 4 m dash, 3 charges, 1.5 s refill each, NO i-frames — position is the defense

entries.desc: pets at 0 HP rest 15 s then return — they never die; they respawn with the hunter

entries.name: Death penalty
entries.desc: lose 25% of carried gold on death (full owner rules: design/12)

entries.desc: FLYING mount, x1.9 speed, crosses water/rock; bonds when the Matriarch falls

entries.desc: M mounts/dismounts; no combat from the saddle; damage knocks you off; flyers must land on solid ground

entries.desc: F on a <35% HP stalker within 3 m; chance 0.25 + 0.6 x missing-HP

entries.name: Instance roll
entries.desc: 2-3 skills from the family pool (~70:30 signature:shared) + 70-110% attribute roll

entries.name: Stables
entries.desc: overflow captures stable the OLDEST bond — pets are never abandoned; swap in CHARACTER → Pets

entries.desc: pets fully tradable; perfect rolls are chase assets (web-only marketplace)

entries.name: Forge upgrade
entries.desc: +10% to all affix values per tier, max +5; cost 50 x 2^tier gold

entries.name: Forge fail risk
entries.desc: attempts into +4/+5 fail 25%/40% — gold burns, the item survives

entries.name: Vendor sell
entries.desc: price scales with rarity and tier (gold sink); per-rarity sell-all chips clear junk in one click

entries.name: Haven chest
entries.desc: 120-slot stash at the Haven; bag <-> chest moves are free, stacks travel whole

entries.name: Item stacking
entries.desc: materials (Spirit Essences) stack into one slot with a qty badge; consuming/selling is stack-aware

entries.name: Player marketplace
entries.desc: real-money player-to-player trade via Pix — WEB-ONLY, never in mobile apps (hard rule)
